descriptions.notStarted: For questions about Aran, you'd better go talk to #bCassandra#k.
descriptions.inProgress: She says in order to obtain the Aran Memory Fragments, you have to first collect Vague Aran Memories.
descriptions.completed: You collected the Vague Aran Memories. Cassandra mentioned a girl that's been waiting patiently at Rien for Aran's revival. What was her name again… Was it Lilin?
